test_title: PYST 07: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Sarah / will singing / at the concert / on Saturday.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. will singing .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is intended to describe a future action.
 
• In the future continuous tense, the correct structure is **"will be + present participle (verb+ing)".**
 
• The segment **"will singing"** is incorrect because "**will**" needs to be followed by "be" to form the correct future continuous tense.
 
• The correct form should be "will be singing". Therefore, the segment "will singing" contains the grammatical error.

Correct sentence: *Sarah will be singing at the concert on Saturday.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Future Continuous Tense:**

 
 
• **Structure:** Subject + will be + verb (base form + ing)
 
• **Example:** They will be traveling to Europe next month.
 
• **Usage:** Describes an ongoing action that will happen in the future.
 
 
 
• **Present Participle (verb+ing):** The form of the verb used to indicate continuous action.
